metadata.name: Circular shadow fix for album art
metadata.description: Fixes the square shadow you get in some setups when you have any sort of circular album art snippet installed.

files.index.css: .main-nowPlayingView-nowPlayingWidget > div > div:nth-child(1) > div { box-shadow: none !important; } .main-nowPlayingView-coverArt { border-radius: 192px; overflow: hidden; }
